recommendation.case_type: Not as described: buyer claims item size is smaller than expected
recommendation.buyer_claim: The buyer states the terracotta planters are much smaller than they appeared in the listing photos.
recommendation.case_summary: The buyer received the Terracotta Planter Set but is dissatisfied with the size. As the listing photos are currently missing from our records, we lack sufficient evidence to definitively prove the dimensions were accurately represented at the time of purchase.
recommendation.strategy_rationale: Because the listing photos are missing, our evidence is weak and we cannot definitively refute the buyer's claim. Offering a partial refund is a proactive way to resolve the dispute and maintain customer satisfaction without requiring a return.
key_facts: Buyer claims the largest planter is barely 3 inches.
Listing photos are missing from the case file.
Delivery was confirmed via photo at the front door on November 9, 2026.
Return policy requires items to be in original packaging for a full refund.
recommendation.response_text: Hello, thank you for reaching out regarding your Terracotta Planter Set. I am sorry to hear that the size of the planters did not meet your expectations. While our records indicate the items were delivered successfully, I understand your frustration regarding the dimensions. As a gesture of goodwill, I would like to offer a partial refund of $27.50 to resolve this matter. This allows you to keep the items without the need for a return shipment. Please let me know if this is acceptable to you so that we can close this dispute. Thank you for your patience. Fernhill Goods
